inherited_results.title: DP4A MMQ routing
inherited_results.headline: 2.36x matched prefill throughput at 128K in one six-card configuration; not a decode claim.
inherited_results.summary: Adds a selectable DP4A MMQ route for tested quantized SM70 prefill, where the automatic policy chose the generic FP16 tensor-core path. One matched six-card configuration measured 2.36x prefill throughput at 128K; this is not a decode claim.

inherited_results.title: Volta Q4_K and Q5_K DP4A
inherited_results.headline: +33.7% at a 4K prompt and +0.09% at an exact 100K prompt.
inherited_results.summary: Extends the forced DP4A MMQ configuration to the Q4_K and Q5_K quantizations that SM70 previously left on the fallback path. The recorded effect was context-dependent: about 33.7% at a 4K prompt and 0.09% at an exact 100K prompt.

inherited_results.title: Parallel model load
inherited_results.headline: 51-59% faster matched cold-start readiness; not token-generation throughput.
inherited_results.timeline_contexts: cold start; no mmap, direct I/O, or tensor checking
inherited_results.summary: Overlaps independent per-GPU model uploads using positional reads instead of serially sharing one file offset. Matched cold-start controls were 51-59% faster; it is a readiness improvement, not token-generation throughput.

inherited_results.title: Mapped pinned host bridge
inherited_results.headline: Four lossless mapped-pinned staging slots for cross-card boundaries up to 64 MiB.
inherited_results.summary: Makes no-P2P CUDA handoffs explicit through scheduler-visible ownership and a fixed four-slot mapped-pinned staging bridge. Event-ordered reuse preserves lossless cross-card transfers for boundaries up to 64 MiB.

inherited_results.title: Research selector registry
inherited_results.headline: Runtime selector-read reporting; no behavior change by itself.
inherited_results.timeline_headline: selector reads are observable at runtime
inherited_results.summary: Adds runtime-switchable research selectors and activation reporting, so a configured selector whose implementation was dropped cannot silently appear enabled. The registry is infrastructure: it changes no behavior by itself.

inherited_results.title: Prompt graph capture seed
inherited_results.headline: Model-dependent prompt-throughput effect; first observation is captured but not replayed.
inherited_results.timeline_contexts: compatible prompt graphs; batch-one decode release
inherited_results.summary: Captures and instantiates a prompt graph executable on first observation without launching it; only later matching observations replay it. This avoids replaying a mutable first observation from an unproven executable. Recorded throughput effects varied by model family, with a small batch-one decode cost.

inherited_results.title: Device-side mask expansion
inherited_results.headline: Removes repeated expanded-mask uploads for causal masks and sparse-attention block bias.
inherited_results.timeline_contexts: causal mask and sparse-attention block bias
inherited_results.selector_note: none; part of the attention path when built
inherited_results.summary: Publishes a compact row-visibility hint and rebuilds the expanded attention mask on the destination GPU, removing repeated host uploads rather than compressing them. It covers both the causal mask and sparse-attention block bias.
